title: nf-core/tbanalyzer pipeline parameters
description: TB-GVAS aims to democratize analysis by providing a comprehensive and user-friendly toolkit for genomic characterization of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb) pathogens at the species and strain levels

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/tbanalyzer/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

execution_modes.title: Execution modes
execution_modes.description: Select which part of the MTBseq workflow to run.

mode.description: Which bundled MTBC analysis pipeline to run.

mtbseq_only_qc.description: Run read QC only and stop before the MTBseq analysis.

mtbseq_parallel.description: Run the per-sample MTBseq steps as separate parallel processes instead of the single TBfull step.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

mtbseq_options.title: MTBseq options
mtbseq_options.description: MTBseq variant-calling and reference settings. These are exposed as parameters so they can be swept via a -params-file for parameter optimization.

mtbseq_path.description: Name/path of the MTBseq executable inside the container. Rarely needs changing.

mtbseq_cohort_tsv.description: Optional cohort TSV (sample/library per line) for the joint analysis. Derived from the samplesheet when not provided.

mtbseq_snp_vars.description: Add an additional filter that excludes all variants except SNPs.

mtbseq_lowfreq_vars.description: Call low-frequency / subpopulation variants distinct from wild type. Output from this detection mode must not be used for phylogenetic analysis.

mtbseq_minbqual.description: Minimum base quality used for the mpileup creation.

mtbseq_mincovf.description: Minimum forward read coverage threshold. Alleles with lower forward coverage are not considered.

mtbseq_project.description: Project/analysis name used by MTBseq to label output files.

mtbseq_minphred.description: Minimum number of reads indicating an allele with a phred score of at least 20.

mtbseq_minfreq.description: Minimum allele frequency (percentage) for an allele to be called.

mtbseq_unambig.description: Minimum percentage of samples with unambiguous information for a position.

mtbseq_window.description: Window size in which multiple variants within the same sample cause the positions to be excluded.

mtbseq_distance.description: SNP distance used to classify samples into groups via agglomerative clustering.

mtbseq_mincovr.description: Minimum reverse read coverage threshold. Alleles with lower reverse coverage are not considered.

mtbseq_ref_and_indexes_path.description: Directory holding the reference genome and its BWA indexes.

mtbseq_resilist.description: List of known resistance-associated variant positions for resistance prediction.

mtbseq_intregions.description: List of interesting regions used for annotation of detected variants.

mtbseq_categories.description: Gene categories file annotating essential/non-essential genes and repetitive regions (excluded from phylogeny).

mtbseq_basecalib.description: VCF of known SNPs used for base quality recalibration.

magma_options.title: MAGMA options
magma_options.description: Parameters for the MAGMA analysis mode (vendored TORCH-consortium/magma nf-core port). Active when --mode magma.

magma_input_samplesheet.description: Path to the MAGMA samplesheet CSV file.
magma_input_samplesheet.help_text: MAGMA samplesheet must have columns: study, sample, library, attempt, flowcell, lane, index_sequence, r1, r2. The study id cannot start with 'XBS_REF_'.

magma_vcf_name.description: Base name for the joint output VCF file. Used to derive the JOINT_NAME.

magma_ref_fasta_basename.description: Basename of the reference FASTA file (without extension). Used for chromosome renaming in SnpEff and TBprofiler.

magma_ref_fasta_dir.description: Directory containing the reference genome files.

magma_ref_fasta.description: Path to the reference FASTA file.

magma_ref_fasta_fai.description: Path to the reference FASTA index (.fai) file.

magma_ref_fasta_dict.description: Path to the reference FASTA sequence dictionary (.dict) file.

magma_ref_fasta_amb.description: Path to the BWA index .amb file.

magma_ref_fasta_ann.description: Path to the BWA index .ann file.

magma_ref_fasta_bwt.description: Path to the BWA index .bwt file.

magma_ref_fasta_pac.description: Path to the BWA index .pac file.

magma_ref_fasta_sa.description: Path to the BWA index .sa file.

magma_ref_fasta_gb.description: Path to the reference GenBank (.gb) annotation file.

magma_ref_fasta_rdanalyzer.description: Path to the RD-Analyzer reference FASTA file (for region-of-difference analysis).

magma_use_ref_gvcf.description: Include the bundled reference GVCF (EXIT-RIF lineage panel) when combining GVCFs. Recommended for low-diversity datasets (<20 samples).

magma_ref_gvcf.description: Path to the reference GVCF file (e.g. EXIT-RIF lineage panel).

magma_ref_gvcf_tbi.description: Path to the tabix index (.tbi) for ref_gvcf.

magma_dbsnp_vcf.description: Path to the known-variants VCF used as dbSNP resource for BQSR and VQSR (Benavente 2015, UVP-approved).

magma_benavente2015_vcf.description: Benavente 2015 VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR resource.

magma_coll2014_vcf.description: Coll 2014 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

magma_coll2018_vcf.description: Coll 2018 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

magma_napier2020_vcf.description: Napier 2020 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

magma_walker2015_vcf.description: Walker 2015 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

magma_zeng2018_vcf.description: Zeng 2018 truth VCF (UVP-approved, rRNA-excluded) used as VQSR truth resource.

magma_excluded_loci_list.description: List of loci to exclude from variant calling (UVP exclusion list).

magma_rrna_list.description: List of rRNA loci to exclude from phylogenetic analysis.

magma_drgenes_list.description: List of WHO Tier 1 and Tier 2 drug resistance genes.

magma_queries_multifasta.description: Multi-FASTA file of IS element query sequences for ISMapper structural variant analysis.

magma_cutoff_median_coverage.description: Minimum median genome coverage required to retain a sample.

magma_cutoff_breadth_of_coverage.description: Minimum fraction of the reference genome covered (breadth) required to retain a sample.

magma_cutoff_rel_abundance.description: Minimum relative abundance of the majority strain required to retain a sample (mixed-infection filter).

magma_cutoff_ntm_fraction.description: Maximum fraction of NTM DNA allowed before a sample is flagged and excluded.

magma_cutoff_site_representation.description: Minimum fraction of samples that must have a call at a site for the site to be included in phylogenetic analysis.

magma_cutoff_strand_bias.description: P-value threshold below which binomial strand bias is considered significant (0 = disabled, recommended for Mtb).

magma_only_validate_fastqs.description: Stop after FASTQ validation and FastQC — do not proceed to mapping or variant calling.

magma_skip_merge_analysis.description: Skip cohort-level joint genotyping, VQSR, phylogeny and resistance summary steps.

magma_skip_variant_recalibration.description: Skip VQSR (Variant Quality Score Recalibration) and use hard-filter thresholds instead. Use when cohort is too small for VQSR.

magma_skip_base_recalibration.description: Skip GATK Base Quality Score Recalibration (BQSR). Recommended for Mtb — BQSR requires large genomes and is not suitable for low-diversity organisms.

magma_skip_minor_variants_gatk.description: Skip GATK HaplotypeCaller in EMIT_ALL_ACTIVE_SITES mode for minor variant detection (LoFreq is preferred).

magma_skip_phylogeny_and_clustering.description: Skip IQ-TREE phylogenetic reconstruction and ClusterPicker cluster assignment.

magma_skip_complex_regions.description: Skip IncComplex region analysis of the merged cohort VCF.

magma_skip_ntmprofiler.description: Skip NTM-Profiler classification of reads as non-tuberculous mycobacteria.

magma_skip_tbprofiler_fastq.description: Skip TBprofiler analysis run directly on FASTQ files (per-sample, pre-mapping).

magma_skip_ismapper.description: Skip ISMapper IS-element insertion site detection.

magma_iqtree_standard_bootstrap.description: Run IQ-TREE with standard bootstrap (-b 1000). Recommended default.

magma_iqtree_fast_ml_only.description: Run IQ-TREE for maximum-likelihood tree only, without bootstrap (fast but no branch support).

magma_iqtree_fast_bootstrapped_phylogeny.description: Run IQ-TREE with ultrafast bootstrap (--bb 1000). Fast approximation.

magma_iqtree_accurate_ml_only.description: Run IQ-TREE with thorough ML search (no bootstrap, slower but more accurate topology).

magma_snpeff_genome_id.description: SnpEff genome database identifier. Must match a built database in snpeff_db_dir.

magma_snpeff_config_file.description: Path to the SnpEff configuration file (snpEff.config).

magma_snpeff_db_dir.description: Directory containing the SnpEff genome database for snpeff_genome_id.

magma_should_publish_bam.description: Publish BAM files output by GATK HaplotypeCaller. Disabled by default to save disk space.
